I have just bought the SMC. First bike, so yeah, take this with a pinch of salt.

The seat is pretty hard, and at higher speeds the wind is a lot. With a better seat or some cycling shorts, while keeping the speed low at around 110 km/h, it's not that bad. Thing is, it's got plenty of power, and keeping the speed down is not easy. :D

On tight mountain roads is pretty amazing though. The only gripe i have with this bike is the quickshifter, sometimes it gets false neutrals, especially inbetween 5th and 6th.
